summary: Electron-based Console loses SSO session after edge proxy upgrade due to SameSite cookie behaviour
description:
Issue summary: After a rolling upgrade of the edge proxy on 2026-03-13 22:15 UTC, several engineers reported being logged out of the Electron-based Redwood Console and failing subsequent SSO-based CLI logins. Impact: internal Console sessions are dropped and CLI SSO token refreshes fail for users on macOS and Linux Electron clients; affects ~15% of active internal sessions in us-east for the 23:00–00:30 UTC window. This is interrupting feature flag work and deploy dashboards.

Observed behaviour: web SSO in browsers is unaffected; only Electron-based Console (desktop app) and the embedded webview used by the rdctl CLI fail to preserve the Okta session cookie after authentication. Users receive a re-login loop in the app and rdctl oauth login returns a 'missing_session_cookie' error.

Relevant history: Edge proxy (release v3.2.0) introduced stricter cookie defaults as part of a cross-site mitigation change. The proxy now sets 'SameSite=Lax' on session cookies by default under certain upstream header conditions. Electron's embedded webview/electron versions in our build do not treat SameSite identically to Chrome in an OS webview context, causing the cookie to be omitted on the subsequent request to the Console frontend.

Impacting teams: Platform, Developer Tools, and anyone using desktop Console for admin/RBAC tasks.
steps_to_reproduce: Install Redwood Console v1.4.2 (Electron build) on macOS
Open the app and trigger SSO login (Okta) from the landing page
Complete MFA challenge in browser popup; return to the app
Observe the app returning to login screen instead of session landing; rdctl login similarly fails with 'missing_session_cookie'
logs: console-webview ERR: Set-Cookie 'rwd_session=...; Path=/; Secure; SameSite=Lax'
comments: 2026-03-13 23:01 - Aisha Kumar: Noticed multiple engineers reporting re-login loops in desktop Console after proxy upgrade. Browser SSO unaffected. Escalating to on-call.
2026-03-13 23:18 - Diego Morales (on-call): Investigating; adding auth and proxy teams. Captured sample request/response showing SameSite header is set to Lax on rwd_session cookie in proxy v3.2.0.

2026-03-13 23:45 - Martina Li (Auth Eng): Reproduced locally with Electron v12. Electron webview refused cookie on follow-up navigation when SameSite=Lax is present and initial redirect came from cross-site context. Patch ready to test that forces SameSite=None for session cookie for known electron clients.

2026-03-14 00:12 - Diego Morales: Rolled back edge-proxy to v3.1.7 in us-east to mitigate; sessions restored for affected users. Keeping incident In Progress to validate fix and harden proxy configuration.
2026-03-14 08:36 - Platform Eng (release): Opened PR to add client-detection flag and explicit SameSite=None+Secure header for desktop app flows. Linked in related_github_prs.
investigation_notes: Proxy v3.2.0 defaulted to SameSite=Lax under 'cross-site mitigation' flag; previously proxy set SameSite=None for session cookies for oauth flows.
Electron webview behaviour differs from Chrome: cookies with SameSite=Lax set during cross-site redirects are dropped on subsequent navigations in the embedded context.
Reproducible via curl: simulate auth callback then check Cookie header absence when SameSite=Lax is set vs present when SameSite=None.
Affected builds: Console v1.4.0 - v1.4.3 (Electron runtime v12-v13). Non-electron browser clients unaffected.
Mitigation performed: rollback to proxy v3.1.7 in us-east; SSO flows returned to normal within ~10 minutes after rollback.
Root cause hypothesis: Overly broad SameSite default introduced in proxy release without explicit exception for OAuth callback flows and known embedded clients (Electron/rdctl).
resolution: Mitigation applied: rolled back edge-proxy in prod/us-east to v3.1.7 which restores SameSite=None behaviour for our oauth session cookie. Follow-up: PR opened to add explicit SameSite=None for oauth session cookies and a client-detection rule for embedded Electron clients; scheduled canary for proxy v3.2.1 that includes the fix. Engineering will add an e2e test covering Electron SSO flow and update runbook. Monitoring: added dashboard alert when >5% of desktop Console SSO logins fail within 30m.
